general_information.Syllabus Name: Advanced Corporate Finance_Tài chính doanh nghiệp nâng cao
general_information.Time Allocation: Study hour (150h) = 45h (60 sessions) contact hours + 1h final exam + 104h self-study
general_information.Description: The course provides students with continuous corporate finance theories relating to a firm's financial decision, working capital management, how to manage its financial performance more effectively to survive competition and takeover in a practical environment. Upon successful completion, students will have the knowledge and skills to: * Discuss theories and practices of capital structure selection, and payout policy; * Discuss practices to optimize the use of net working capital; * Design a long-term financial plan for an organization; * Critically evaluate finance theories, concepts, assumptions, limitations and arguments. Topics include: Capital Budgeting, Capital Rationing and The Cost of Capital, Working Capital Management, Capital Raising for a Firm, Financial Planning and Forecasting, Capital Structure and Dividend Policy, Corporate Risk Management.
general_information.StudentTasks: - Class attendance is strongly encouraged. Attend at least 80% of class hours in order to be accepted to the final examination - Actively participate in class activities - Fulfill tasks given by instructor after class - Use their own laptop in class only for learning purpose - Read the textbook in advance - Access the course website (http://flm.fpt.edu.vn) for up-to-date information and material of the course, for online supports from teachers and other students and for practicing and assessment.
general_information.Tools: - Internet - Use of AI: students are permitted to utilise AI tools to assist with class discussions on the Edunext platform and to support content outlining and slide preparation for both individual and group assignments.

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: Explain the implications of theory for practical financial management
Compare various models of investment decision making under uncertainty
Distinguish various types of corporate risk and hedging management choice

Apply critical thinking, problem solving and presentation skills to individual and/or group activities dealing with advanced corporate finance and demonstrate in an individual summative assessment task the acquisition of a comprehensive understanding of the topics covered in corporate finance.
Practice ability to work collaboratively within a team to prepare to prepare a clear oral report and/or academic written report

assessments.Question Type: Each student should make at least 1 individual presentation during the course in front of the class. Topics will be varied based on the topics in the textbook. In addition, students are required to do exercises and other activities
assessments.Note: Participation scores will be given based on students' class attendance, preparation, quantity as well as quality of participation in classroom; quality of participation is demonstrated through asking relevant questions, making statements that add to and facilitate class discussions, and building upon others’ comments. **Students may use AI tools to support information searching, argument structuring, and critical thinking when answering questions or participating in group discussions on the Edunext platform. Requirements: • Use clear and specific prompts • Avoid copy-pasting • Rephrase and verify, add personal insights, real-world examples
